resources.string: Nothing logged yet. Add a meal by search or as a typed list.
Log food by search or as a typed list (“buckwheat 200 g, cutlet”). Tarilka counts calories, protein, fibre and fluids and shows habits as coloured badges, without judgement.

Sleep, cycle, workouts, bowel, Why I eat and reminders can be turned on in Options whenever you want. Start with the profile: height, weight and goal, and Tarilka works out your targets. One question to finish: are you 18 or older? Under 18 Tarilka shows no calories.

Foods you searched for that are not in the database (times in brackets). Kept only on this phone. You can add any of them yourself: Foods → New food. To get them into the database for everyone, tap Send the list: the list is passed to GitHub as the page opens and stays in the browser history; you can edit it there, and it is published from your account only when you confirm.
